description: SBOM fields BOMHort recognises beyond its built-in ones. Each field is read from a fixed list of CycloneDX places: metadata.component.properties and metadata.properties by property name, metadata.component.externalReferences by type. Earlier sources come first. SPDX is not supported yet. Changes apply to SBOMs ingested afterwards.

fields.name: owner_contact
fields.description: Team or person who answers for the component (e-mail, chat channel or URL).
